shortDescription: Qfin Holdings NASDAQ:QFIN announced a senior leadership transition and board restructuring, effective September 21, 2026. CEO and Director Haisheng Wu has stepped down from his executive and board roles to focus full-time on driving the company's international business expansion and long-term globa…

children: and board restructuring, effective September 21, 2026. CEO and Director Haisheng Wu has stepped down from his executive and board roles to focus full-time on driving the company's international business expansion and long-term global strategy.
The board of directors has appointed Yan Zheng to succeed Wu as CEO and board member. Zheng has served as the company’s Chief Risk Officer since July 2020 and as Vice President since February 2017.

Bringing 18 years of consumer finance risk management expertise to the post, Zheng previously co-founded Shenzhen Samoyed Internet Finance Service and held risk management leadership roles within China Merchants Bank.

title: Qfin Holdings appoints Chief Risk Officer Yan Zheng as CEO to succeed Haisheng Wu
